Roche finds another oncology gem in Asia with $1.5B B cell disease partnership
snippet: Roche has tapped Simcere Zaiming for a new T cell engager that could have broad application in B cell–mediated diseases including lymphoma and autoimmune conditions.

title: GSK to launch Phase 3 trial for mRNA-based flu vaccine amid resurgence for the modality
snippet: GSK’s vaccine—which targets two primary flu antigens—elicited higher immune responses in both younger and older adults in a mid-stage study. The Phase 3 launch, planned for September, follows the FDA's recent approval for Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine.

title: Cellares trims workforce again, laying off 68 in New Jersey
snippet: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

title: ArsenalBio sacrifices ‘majority’ of staff in pivot to in vivo CAR T
snippet: After downsizing by 50% last year, Arsenal Biosciences is again laying off employees. This time, 99 people are getting cut as part of a strategic shift to focus the company’s R&D efforts on in vivo CAR T therapies.

title: 9 midsize drugmakers climb aboard Trump’s MFN train
snippet: Astellas Pharma, BridgeBio, BeOne Medicines and six other large biotechs join the 17 Big Pharmas that previously signed on to President Donald Trump’s Most Favored Nation (MFN) drug pricing program, representing some 89% of the branded drug market.

title: Novartis pauses CAR T studies due to 3 deaths; BMS follows suit after safety events
snippet: Novartis suspended multiple studies of a CAR T candidate after three patients who received the therapy suffered fatal cases of immune effector cell-associated hemophagocytic syndrome. BMS, meanwhile, paused some CAR T trials after separately observing “transient and reversible inflammatory events" with its therapy.

title: Biomarin nabs big royalties in achondroplasia patent settlement with Ascendis
snippet: Biomarin has granted Ascendis a non-exclusive, worldwide license to use navepegritide, the active ingredient in the latter company’s recently approved achondroplasia drug Yuviwel, in exchange for 18–20% royalties on net sales.

title: Arrowhead's new Redemplo findings in severe hypertriglyceridemia have analysts split
snippet: Safety and dosing are likely to be “key differentiators” for Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals as it looks to challenge Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ lead in the severe hypertriglyceridemia market.

title: Deal-hungry Lilly strikes up to $2.9B immuno play for Merida
snippet: With the acquisition of Merida Biosciences, Eli Lilly is gaining a precision degradation platform for therapies that selectively target and destroy pathologic antibodies for allergic and autoimmune diseases.

title: Takeda, Protagonist score broad FDA nod in rare blood cancer, setting up $2B opportunity
snippet: The approval of rusfertide—now to be branded Mimrylo—for polycythemia vera marks a key win for Takeda, which now has crossed the FDA finish line for two of three critical product launches slated for the coming year.

title: BMS’ neuro renaissance was built on back of Celgene mega-merger
snippet: Well-known for its oncology efforts and making recent headlines for a rumored mega merger with AstraZeneca, Bristol Myers Squibb is also dedicating considerable resources to neurological and psychiatric diseases, with a “continuum of care” mindset.

title: China poses increasing security risk as US biotech innovation edge erodes
snippet: The U.S. is scrambling to compete with a strategically positioned China on the biotech stage as the Asian country surpasses America in biomedical research and clinical trials. So far, China is winning.

title: BioNTech halts mid-stage trial of personalized mRNA vaccine in colorectal cancer
snippet: Shares of Germany-based BioNTech were down as much as 8% Friday after announcing a Phase 2 trial of autogene cevumeran would be discontinued for futility. The news follows Merck and Moderna’s Phase 3 win last week for their cancer vaccine plus Keytruda in melanoma.

title: ‘Worse than expected’ Wainua data muddies water for TTR silencers
snippet: AstraZeneca and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ data drop divulging more details from its highly watched Phase 3 transthyretin silencer trial “further confuses the picture” for Wainua when combined with the standard of care for ATTR-CM, analysts say.

title: BioXcel files for bankruptcy, will sell assets to Teva for up to $125M
snippet: Teva Pharmaceuticals is the 'stalking horse bidder' to kick off the auction process for BioXcel Therapeutics' AI-derived assets as the biotech files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

title: Lilly joins Novo in cardiovascular space after FDA nod for GLP-1/GIP agonist Mounjaro
snippet: With the approval, Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro becomes the first dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist indicated to lower the risk of heart attack, stroke or cardiovascular death in adults with type 2 diabetes.

title: Genentech strikes second Asia deal in a week, betting up to $1B in oncology ADC alliance with DualityBio
snippet: Through its DualityBio deal, Roche's Genentech hopes to create antibody-drug conjugates with payloads that can circumvent growing cancer drug resistance.

title: Priovant nabs first FDA approval for targeted tablet in dermatomyositis
snippet: Lisraya carries a boxed warning typical of JAK inhibitors, but otherwise has a broad label that allows use in all adults with the rare autoimmune disease, setting up the drug for blockbuster status in a few years, according to Leerink.

title: AstraZeneca, Amgen poised to challenge Dupixent’s reign with esophagitis win
snippet: Even without specific Phase 3 data yet revealed, analysts see AstraZeneca and Amgen’s Tezspire as a potential threat for Dupixent in eosinophilic esophagitis.

title: Multispecifics are transforming the CDMO development architecture
snippet: Manufacturers are being pushed beyond mAb‑era platforms into a new design model built around molecular engineering, complex analytics and amplified upstream and downstream processing.

title: Chaotic adcomms threaten to derail FDA’s bid to renew trust after Makary, Prasad
snippet: The FDA has been trying to mend fences with rare disease drug developers and patient groups since the departure of former Commissioner Marty Makary three months ago. But advisory committee meetings last week for Replimune and Capricor Therapeutics only created more confusion and frustration.

title: Biotech’s China problem: An issue of national security or economic value for the US?
snippet: Congressional letters sent to the CEOs of Eli Lilly, Pfizer, Merck, BMS and AbbVie this week voicing concerns about the pharmas' clinical trials in China highlight an ongoing discrepancy in how government and industry think about the rise of the Asian country’s biotech industry.

title: BIO 2026: Cell and gene therapy sector must break the mold to thrive
snippet: If cell and gene therapy makers are going to achieve their mission to improve patients’ lives, the industry must come together to share information across stakeholders, from regulators to manufacturers to payers.

title: At FDA, ‘caretaker mode’ is better than power trip mode
snippet: UniQure’s planned third-quarter submission for its Huntington’s disease gene therapy may be a harbinger of a more flexible FDA under acting commissioner Kyle Diamantas—but how long will it last? And how can companies be sure these positive decisions won’t just be reversed?
